summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting board approval of shareholder remuneration: R$8.64 billion total, comprising R$6.68 billion JCP (R$1.5687/share) and R$1.97 billion dividends (R$0.4620/share), payable September 2, 2026. The per-share amount may adjust based on shares outstanding as of the August 10 record date due to the February 2025 buyback program. The board approved unanimously with Fiscal Council no objections. This is a routine capital return special situation; watch for the final per-share adjustment and any future buyback or distribution announcements.
